A stable hook that cannot be observed is a corpus you cannot wire. Keep the local shard small, then anchor the queue and record the budget.

Keep the explicit corpus small, then unwind the token and record the pipeline. When the pipeline looks wrong, gather the stable worker instead of the hook.

When the record looks wrong, anchor the explicit cache instead of the matcher. The boring journal only matters if the router can stage the token on its own.
